name: GTA V Map
description: Streamed Los Santos / Blaine County map with Quake 3 player kinematics

unit_scale.explanation: GTA V authors its world in metres and one engine unit is one metre, so map coordinates are consumed unscaled. Only the axis convention changes.

axis_convention.critical: Applied once, by the C++ readers as they read the extracted files. Nothing downstream re-maps axes.

world_bounds_metres.note: Expressed in engine (Y-up) space after the axis mapping above.

player.explanation: Movement is the ioq3 pmove pipeline already implemented in this engine (q3.pm.*). GTA V and Quake 3 agree once both are expressed in metres, so no retuning is needed.

asset_pipeline.reason: The shipped map archives are NG-encrypted RPF7 and cannot be read without circumventing their encryption. See README.md.
asset_pipeline.expected_input: the extracted levels/gta5 folder, named by map_dir on gta5.assets.index; assets/tiles/ is a legacy fallback
